summary: Rates, 50A, FCFS, May 1-Oct 31 confirmed; low $20->$15 (non-electric base, no tent-only wording). Not waterfront stays: canopy-blind.
flags: WATERFRONT, canopy-blind: stays not waterfront. Esri z17 at the pin shows unbroken summer canopy; no pads visible. An old channel is about 130 m north and the main Cedar about 240 m NE. No site-level source read; the county's own Bremer page returned 500 (not retried), so 'set back from the bank' in the note rests on the earlier sweep.
WEBSITE: second line https://www.bremercounty.iowa.gov/government/conservation_board_/campgrounds_parks.php returned 500 today; may be temporary, re-check before removing.
Base low changed on the strength of a non-electric price with no statement that those sites suit RVs; 20 is the base if you read non-electric as tent sites.
note: Bremer County Conservation park ~1.5 mi NW of Waverly on the Cedar River (180 acres, largest county park). Some gravel-pad sites; self-registration kiosk. Camping is in river-bottom timber, set back from the bank. --Claude
